---
title: "Multi-trait models"
format: html
---

MTBLR samples a complete joint model per logical chain. Trait-sharing patterns
combine with BayesR components through one unique null state and deterministic
pattern/component ordering.

`mtblr_bed()` supports `bayesc`, `bayesr`, and `bayesrc` with diagonal or full
residual covariance. `mtblr_csr()` and `mtblr_block_eigen()` support
`sbayesc`, `sbayesr`, and `sbayesrc`; summary routes use their identified
residual-covariance contract.

Full covariance summaries are distinct from the five iteration × trait
variance traces. Multichain seeds and results are deterministic and independent
of worker assignment.

The [MT BayesR/SBayesR](../methods/mt_bayesr_sbayesr.qmd) and
[MT BayesRC/SBayesRC](../methods/mt_bayesrc_sbayesrc.qmd) pages define the
joint state space, probability outputs, and annotation factorization.
